value.subject: ACCHCO terminal transformation – initial scope
value.bodyPreview: Felix, following the RFP from Alexandria Container & Cargo Handling Co, I've had a first call with their Operations Director, Yusuf El-Masri. ACCHCO runs the main container terminal at the Port of Alexandria and wants a full operational transformation.

body.content:
Felix,

following the RFP from Alexandria Container & Cargo Handling Co, I've had a first call with their Operations Director, Yusuf El-Masri. ACCHCO runs the main container terminal at the Port of Alexandria and wants a full operational transformation — yard restructuring, berth scheduling, and equipment deployment.

I'd like you to lead the modeling. Proposing we call the engagement 'Transformation at ACCHCO'.

Michael Dempsey
Managing Director, RPX Optimization (US)

value.subject: RE: ACCHCO terminal transformation – initial scope
value.bodyPreview: Sounds good Michael, I'll lead the modeling side. I've looked at the RFP — ACCHCO's main constraints are an aging straddle-carrier fleet and severe yard congestion in peak season. Suggest a three-phase structure: diagnostics, redesign, implementation support.

body.content:
Sounds good Michael,

I'll lead the modeling side. I've looked at the RFP — ACCHCO's main constraints are an aging straddle-carrier fleet and severe yard congestion in peak season. I'll prepare a project plan.

Suggest a three-phase structure: diagnostics, redesign, implementation support.

Felix Kasiske
Managing Director, RPX Optimization GmbH

value.subject: Welcome to the project / kickoff scheduling
value.bodyPreview: Dear Mr. Kasiske, thank you for the project plan. I'm Yusuf El-Masri, Operations Director at Alexandria Container & Cargo Handling Co. We are pleased to proceed with the Transformation at ACCHCO engagement.

body.content:
Dear Mr. Kasiske,

thank you for the project plan. I'm Yusuf El-Masri, Operations Director at Alexandria Container & Cargo Handling Co. We are pleased to proceed with the Transformation at ACCHCO engagement. The three-phase structure works for us.

Can we schedule the kickoff for the week of March 23rd at our offices in Alexandria?

Best regards,
Yusuf El-Masri
Operations Director, Alexandria Container & Cargo Handling Co

value.subject: Kickoff notes – Transformation at ACCHCO
value.bodyPreview: Good kickoff in Alexandria today. Phase 1 diagnostics now underway. Yusuf gave us full access to ACCHCO's terminal operating system data. Key finding already: their yard utilization peaks at 94% — far above the 75% best-practice threshold.

body.content:
Good kickoff in Alexandria today. Phase 1 diagnostics now underway.

Yusuf gave us full access to ACCHCO's terminal operating system data. Key finding already: their yard utilization peaks at 94% — far above the 75% best-practice threshold. Felix is building the simulation model.

Michael Dempsey
Managing Director, RPX Optimization (US)

value.subject: Phase 1 diagnostics complete
value.bodyPreview: Michael, Yusuf — Phase 1 is complete. The simulation confirms the yard congestion is driven by poor block allocation, not lack of space. We can recover roughly 20% effective capacity through re-zoning alone.

body.content:
Michael, Yusuf —

Phase 1 is complete. The simulation confirms the yard congestion is driven by poor block allocation, not lack of space. We can recover roughly 20% effective capacity through re-zoning alone. Moving into Phase 2 redesign.

Yusuf, I'll need two days with your operations team in early May.

Felix Kasiske
Managing Director, RPX Optimization GmbH

value.subject: RE: Phase 1 diagnostics complete
value.bodyPreview: Excellent news, Felix. A 20% capacity recovery without capital expenditure would be a major win for ACCHCO's board. My operations team is available May 5-6. I appreciate RPX's work so far.

body.content:
Excellent news, Felix.

A 20% capacity recovery without capital expenditure would be a major win for ACCHCO's board. My operations team is available May 5-6.

I appreciate RPX's work so far — this is exactly the kind of insight we hoped for.

Yusuf El-Masri
Operations Director, Alexandria Container & Cargo Handling Co
